origin: Deep within a burning labyrinth, the Minotaur waits without moving toward the entrance.
story: Each rung changes the distance without changing the maze.
weakness: The way out is learned one turn at a time.
quotes: The Minotaur never becomes weaker. You simply learn the way out.
unlockText: The trail to The Guardian of the Labyrinth is open.
victoryText: The Guardian of the Labyrinth falls silent.
